grounding.excerpt: The permittee is required to submit a detailed plan to test for Delta-BHC at the source water
shall become effective on January 1, 2022. This permit and the authorization to discharge shall expire at midnight, December 31, 2026.

payload.rationale: The packet establishes only that Delta-BHC is addressed by a source-water intake testing-plan obligation (submit a detailed plan to test at the source water). It does not establish the full special-study / compliance-schedule characterization, does not show whether any enforceable numeric discharge limit for Delta-BHC applies in FY2025, and does not ground the downstream claim that DMR absence of Delta-BHC is not by itself a discharge-limit exceedance. Positive intake-study language is insufficient to close the negative limb (not a routine FY2025 DMR numeric limit) without closed-world inference from absence of limit text in this partial excerpt. Neither ACCEPT nor REJECT burden is met; UNRESOLVED is the correct disposition.
